cases.name: Nexus of Becoming
cases.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, draw a card. Then you may exile an artifact or creature card from your hand. If you do, create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 3/3 Golem artifact creature in addition to its other types.

cases.name: Panoptic Mirror
cases.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may copy a card exiled with this artifact. If you do, you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

cases.name: Jon Irenicus, Shattered One
cases.text: At the beginning of your end step, target opponent gains control of up to one target creature you control. Put two +1/+1 counters on it and tap it. It's goaded for the rest of the game and it gains "This creature can't be sacrificed."

cases.name: Unrelated Witness
cases.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, draw a card. Then you may discard a card. If you do, create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 3/3 Golem artifact creature in addition to its other types.

cases.name: Nexus of Becoming
cases.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, draw two cards. Then you may exile an artifact or creature card from your hand. If you do, create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 3/3 Golem artifact creature in addition to its other types.
